svg.title: Mission briefing — Mohamad Kanso
svg.desc: Terminal briefing. Senior Forward Deployed AI Associate at 7IM, London. MSci Data Science, City, University of London. Building and governing production AI agents. 40% latency reduction across 50M-record Databricks pipelines; 80% cost reduction with a fully local LLM stack; Hermes Agent 21 authored + 13 co-authored commits on main; First-Class dissertation (76%); winner of the Computer Vision Challenge and the Cognizant Vibe Challenge.
